differences.reason: MoonBit String requires valid UTF-8; Go strings also accept arbitrary bytes.
Invalid UTF-8 user information is rejected rather than propagated as a Go byte string.
URI input is bounded to 64 KiB before parsing.
Literal control characters are rejected everywhere; Go accepts them in an ignored fragment.
Ignored fragments must still decode as valid UTF-8.
A query pair containing invalid UTF-8 is discarded like a malformed query escape; Go retains the byte string.

scope: Exact parsed values, canonical string and acceptance compared with pinned unmodified Go implementation on this compiler; error wording is intentionally redacted and not compared. Parse behavior does not prove TCP/TLS connection behavior.
